title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
partTitle: Acts 2 - The Passion of the Early Church
partTitleZh: 初代教會的同心相愛與忠心倍增
summaryZh: 初代教會在相愛同心與考驗中持續忠心，讓神將國度倍增的突破託付給他們。
lines: Acts 2 is clearly a chapter about a great and powerful outpouring of the Holy Spirit that had such an incredible impact.
《使徒行傳》第二章顯然是關於聖靈偉大而大有能力的澆灌，帶來了如此不可思議的影響力。
And the momentum of chapter 2 continued for many years.
而第二章所帶動的這股動能，持續了許多年。
In fact, I've heard it said that what we're going to read, starting with verse 42, actually describes about the last five years.
事實上，我曾聽人說，我們從第 42 節開始要讀的這段經文，其實描繪了差不多後續五年的歷程。
So, I don't know the exact length of time, but it's a certain period.
所以，我不知道確切的時間有多長，但那是長達一段時期的過程。
It's not that the Holy Spirit came down on Friday; it's the report they wrote on Sunday.
這並不是說聖靈在週五降臨，而這就是他們在週日寫出來的報告。
This is years of practice, and pay attention to it.
這是多年的操練，請留心注意這一點。
It is the years of what they did that allowed them to succeed in God's task.
正是因為他們多年來持之以恆所做的，才使他們在神的使命中得以成功。
They continued steadfastly in the apostles' teaching.
They were constantly dedicating themselves, that seems to be what one of the translations says.
「他們不斷地奉獻自己」，某個譯本似乎是這樣翻譯的。
In other words, they were constantly renewing the covenant, okay?
換句話說，他們不斷地在更新這份約，對吧？
They devoted themselves continually to the apostles' teaching and fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayers.
「都恆心遵守使徒的教訓，彼此交接，擘餅，祈禱。」
專心致力於；把自己獻給
And fear came upon every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
「眾人都懼怕；使徒又行了許多奇事神蹟。」
And all who believed were together and had all things in common,
凡物公用；共享所有東西
And sold their possessions and goods and distributed them to all, as anyone had need.
「並且賣了田產、家業，照各人所需用的分給各人。」
Take a look at this again.
They sold their possessions and property and distributed them among all, as anyone had need.
他們賣了產業和物資，照各人所需用的分給眾人。
What you need to know—because I don't want to teach on this, but I need to make a link here.
你們需要明白的是——雖然我不想在這裡講論這個主題，但我需要在這裡做個連結。
What you need to know about this section is that they sold their possessions, their homes, anything to help the people around them, to take care of crises, problems, and needs.
關於這段經文你們需要知道的是，他們變賣田產、房屋，變賣任何東西來幫助周遭的人，以處理危機、問題與各樣需要。
This was not an order given to them.
這並不是向他們下達的命令。
This is what they did because of the explosion of compassion they had because they connected with each other.
他們會這麼做，是因為彼此連結而在心中爆發出極大的憐憫。
This was not a rule, this was not Christian communism.
這不是一項硬性規定，這不是基督徒共產主義。
This was not a rule of wealth redistribution, so to speak.
可以說，這絕不是某種財富再分配的規條。
This is what compassion looks like when you are connected to people you truly care about,
當你與真心在乎的人緊密連結時，憐憫就是這個樣子的；
And you know they are living by faith, and you want to make sure they are living a victorious life with you.
你知道他們正憑信心生活，而你想確保他們能與你一同過得勝的生活。
"And daily, continuing with one accord in the temple"—notice—"and breaking bread from house to house, they did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart,"
「他們天天同心合意恆切的在殿裡」——注意——「且在家中擘餅，存著歡喜、誠實的心用飯，」
純全誠實的心；純一的心
"Praising God, and having favor with all the people."
"And the Lord added to the church daily those who were being saved."
「主將得救的人天天加給他們。」
We'll read a few of these verses again, but look for a moment at verse 47: "Praising God and having favor with all the people."
我們會再讀幾節這些經文，但請先看一眼第 47 節：「讚美神，得眾民的喜愛。」
My God, what an extraordinary time.
我的神啊，那是多麼不可思議的時代。
The church is a newly created community of people who were changing through submission to Christ;
教會是一個新建立的群體，其中的人藉由順服基督而不斷轉變；
These people had the support of the entire community, the entire city.
這些人得到了整個社區、整座城市的支持。
And as a result, people joined them every day.
結果，每天都有人加入他們。
If you read the first 10 chapters of Acts, you will see that they had periods of incredible favor and then faced incredible resistance.
如果你讀《使徒行傳》前十章，你會看見他們經歷過極蒙恩寵的時期，隨後又面臨巨大的抵擋。
And what is truly striking is that the church responded equally to both favor and persecution.
而真正令人震撼的是，教會對恩寵與對逼迫的反應完全是一樣的。
引人注目的；令人震撼的
對…同等對待/一視同仁地反應
Because of this, somewhere around chapters 10, 11, 12, I don't know exactly where, they got to a point where souls weren't just being added every day anymore.
正因如此，大約在第十、十一或十二章，我不確切記得在哪裡，他們達到了一個地步，靈魂不再只是天天被加添。
如今他們乃是在成倍倍增。
It was growing exponentially in a way they had never known before.
它以前所未見的方式呈指數級倍增。
And it was a breakthrough of endurance, maybe 10 or 15 years of persistence in the works of the Spirit,
這是忍耐所帶來的突破，也許是十到十五年在聖靈工作中的堅持，
As they faithfully celebrated when they were approved, and faithfully celebrated when they were opposed.
因為無論是受到稱許還是遭受反對，他們都以忠心頌讚神。
And because of this, God entrusted them with multiplication.
正因如此，神將倍增託付給他們。
They were unanimous in the temple and in their homes.
他們在聖殿裡和在家中都是同心合意的。
A joint gathering is important, a small gathering is also important.
大型的聯合聚會很重要，小組聚會也同樣重要。
There are things that can happen in a large group that won't happen in a small one.
有些事會在大群體中發生，卻不會在小群體中發生。
And there are things that happen in a small group that won't happen in a large one.
也有些事會在小群體中發生，卻不會在大群體中發生。
Each of them has its place in shaping and defining who we are and how we will live our lives.
兩者在塑造和界定我們是誰、以及我們將如何度過一生上，都各有其不可或缺的地位。
